summary: Brookfield Corporation furnished a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026 attaching a press release announcing it will host its third quarter 2026 results conference call and webcast on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET, with results released approximately 7:00 a.m. ET that morning. The notice provides pre-registration links for the conference call and webcast, plus a 90-day replay. No transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine earnings-scheduling announcement, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle or deal terms apply.
